unitPolicy.flopsPerToken: FLOP/token, global model work before TP sharding
unitPolicy.bytesPerToken: byte/token, global rank-summed external-memory traffic before TP sharding
unitPolicy.bandwidth: byte/s, sustained or effective bandwidth only
unitPolicy.rule: All executable equations use base SI units. TFLOP and TB/s are presentation-only units.

tpScaling.note: This first-order scaling is calibrated at TP32 and is not a replacement for the Q3-Q6 event replay.

calibration.flopDerivation: 2 x 104.2B active parameters + 1.546948T long-context attention/state FLOP from src/core/design_engine.js

limitations: TP8 and TP16 byte scaling is directional, not observed.
P0 uses the same workload demand as the P1 calibration but a different resource envelope.
Operator-level byte reuse and overlap are deferred to Stage B.
